summary.name: Oscilloscope Graphics (Digital and 3D Aesthetics; provenance explicit).
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: a dark background with a small set of glowing vector traces for waveforms, trajectories, and contours. Modest persistence keeps paths clear. Stable areas are reserved for text. Explicit exclusion: no raster CRT scanlines on the vector display.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: audio-reactive or Lissajous pieces driven by a real signal. Inferred from suggested combinations: music visualizers, album teasers, and live-set backdrops rendered offline, and physics, audio-engineering, or signal-processing education. General narrative or product video suitability is unspecified.
summary.limitations: Explicit: the treatment requires defined signal behavior. Motion must not use arbitrary line wobble. Avoid live microphone input for rendered output, brightness strobing on every beat, and multiple simultaneous traces that cross into illegibility. Labels must stay in stable, readable zones.
summary.palette: Suggested, not supplied: background #081613 as the dark field, foreground #D8F0DD for text and labels, and accent_1 #76CF9B for traces. Three base colors; gradients are disabled. Two-color contrast checks give foreground on background 15.362 and accent on background 9.845, which must be rechecked in composited frames. Task-supplied exact colors override these values.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: motion is driven by a defined signal, explicit functions, or precomputed audio, with fixed sampling and persistence rules. Line weight and persistence stay constant across sections. Optional motion references are motion-012, motion-014, motion-015, and motion-039, but none is required and each needs scene support. Suggested HTML use includes play/pause controls and frequency or phase sliders. Otherwise interaction is unspecified.
summary.audio: Explicit: the style is compatible with precomputed audio data, and live microphone state should not drive offline renders. Inferred: music-synchronized use can switch trace families at verified section boundaries. No fixed music genre, voiceover, sung vocals, or sound effects are mandated. Audio choices are unspecified unless the task supplies them.
summary.assetRequirements: No assets were supplied, so asset availability is unspecified. Needed inputs are a defined signal or explicit trace functions, precomputed audio analysis or event tables for music-driven work, and any approved copy and fonts for the stable text zones. Missing audio or signal data must be reported, not invented.
summary.combinations: Suggested: style-105 supplies a shared beat and section event table that changes trace shapes at verified boundaries, with constant persistence and line weight. Suggested: style-097 supplies labels, a graticule, and parameter readouts for signal concepts, where formulas must match the plotted functions and the accent is reserved for the trace. Use motion-039 only if scene assets support it.
summary.productionApproach: Canvas 2D is the style renderer and draws traces from shared, seekable time, not wall clocks. Web Audio API is a supporting tool for previews only; offline renders use precomputed data. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition and export, with one paused GSAP timeline per composition. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists. Verification of forward, backward, and direct seeks is required.
